skill.name: recovery
skill.description: Recover session state from memory-keeper checkpoints after context loss or a session restart.
skill.summary: Restore recent work context, progress, blockers, and next actions from memory-keeper checkpoints.
skill.author: Barnhardt-Enterprises-Inc

content.value_statement: Context loss can interrupt active work and hide the next action. This skill rebuilds session state from memory-keeper checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Loads recent memory-keeper context items for recovery review.
Requests a memory-keeper summary of stored session context.
Filters progress items and high priority items from stored context.
Extracts current task, modified files, progress, next action, and blockers.
Formats full, partial, and no-context recovery responses.
limitations: Requires memory-keeper data from earlier sessions.
Cannot recover work that was never checkpointed.
May need user confirmation before continuing recovered work.
Does not validate that recovered files still match the current workspace.

use_cases.title: Resume Developer Work
use_cases.description: Restore the last task, changed files, progress, and next action after a context reset.

use_cases.title: Continue Assisted Research
use_cases.description: Recover checkpoints and blockers so a research session can continue from the latest useful state.

use_cases.title: Handoff Ongoing Tasks
use_cases.description: Create a clear recovery summary for another AI assistant or teammate before work continues.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover my previous session and summarize what I was working on.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after a simple session restart.

prompt_templates.title: Recover With Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover my last task, list files that changed, and identify the next action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when returning to development work.

prompt_templates.title: Check For Blockers
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover the session, highlight any blockers, and ask before continuing the next action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when prior work may be incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Handoff Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Recover all relevant checkpoints and produce a concise handoff summary for the next assistant.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before transferring work to another session or teammate.

output_examples.output: Session recovered: previous task, progress, modified files, blockers, recent checkpoints, and a recommended next action.

output_examples.input: I lost context. What should I do next?
output_examples.output: The response identifies available context, missing details, and asks whether to continue, start fresh, or provide more information.
A concise handoff summary with task status, important files, unresolved issues, and the safest next step.

best_practices: Confirm the recovered next action before making changes.
Review modified files against the current workspace state.
Checkpoint important progress before clearing context.
anti_patterns: Assuming recovered context is complete without checking for gaps.
Continuing work before the user confirms the next action.
Using the skill when no memory-keeper checkpoints exist.

faq.question: What does this skill recover?
faq.answer: It recovers stored task context, progress, modified files, blockers, checkpoints, and next actions.

faq.question: Does it restore deleted files?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes stored memory-keeper context and does not restore files from backups.

faq.question: Can it work without memory-keeper data?
faq.answer: No. It can only report that no relevant context was found.

faq.question: Is user confirmation required?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to ask for confirmation before proceeding with recovered work.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it recover partial sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a partial recovery flow that lists available and missing information.
